notes: LocoTrack-small growing clip, N=64, 128x160 NTCHW in [0, 255]. Trace T=2; time axis is dynamic; host keep-first cap is 300 (same as LocoTrackSTIR). Queries (t,x,y) with t=0.
Host: re-run on frames[0:t+1] every step; if T>max_frames keep frame0 + last max-1. Do not pad with the last frame and do not re-query last xy.
Holoscan: LocoTrackHostOp + ORT (not InferenceOp) so T can grow each frame. Keep-first cap max_frames; do not pad or re-query last xy.
ResNet runs in a separate graph (locotrack_stereomis_scale4_feats.onnx) on chunks of 32 frames. The host concatenates features along time and calls this tracker on the full keep-first clip.
